Python Asyncio Guide

Asyncio is Python's built-in library for writing concurrent code using async/await syntax.

The Event Loop

The event loop is the central execution mechanism in asyncio. It runs coroutines and manages I/O operations.

Coroutines

A coroutine is a function defined with async def. It can pause execution using await.

async def fetch_data():
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
    return "data"

Tasks and Gather

Use asyncio.gather() to run multiple coroutines concurrently.
